# Shop settings

Each shop's settings, changed in the admin panel under Settings (appearance ones on the Bot menu screen) or through `PUT /api/admin/settings`. Secret values are stored encrypted and never returned.

## General

| Key | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `bot_enabled` | bool | true | Bot is on. When off, only staff can use the bot |
| `languages` | list | ["fa", "en"] | Bot languages. Language codes, e.g. fa, en |
| `require_phone` | bool | false | Ask for phone number. People share their number before using the bot |
| `phone_country_codes` | list | [] | Allowed country codes. For example 98; empty allows all |
| `support_username` | str | "" | Support username. Without @ |
| `terms_required` | bool | false | Require terms |
| `terms_version` | int | 1 | Terms version. Raising it asks everyone to accept again |

## Free trial

| Key | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `trial_enabled` | bool | true | Free trial on |
| `trial_panel_id` | int | — | Trial panel. Panel number; empty uses the first active panel |
| `trial_days` | int | 1 | Trial days |
| `trial_gb` | int | 1 | Trial data (GB) |
| `trial_generation` | int | 1 | Trial round. Raising it lets everyone take a trial again |
| `trial_daily_quota` | int | 0 | Daily trial limit. 0 means no limit |
| `trial_requires_phone` | bool | false | Trial needs phone |

## Referrals

| Key | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `referral_enabled` | bool | true | Referrals on |
| `referral_percent` | int | 10 | Reward percent. Of the referred person's first purchase |
| `loyalty_enabled` | bool | false | Loyalty levels. Customers who spend more get a standing discount. Resellers keep their own discount |
| `loyalty_tiers` | list | [] | Levels. Total spent on completed orders to reach each level, and its discount (up to 50%) |
| `wheel_enabled` | bool | false | Lucky wheel. A Lucky wheel button in the bot gives a spin with a prize from the list below |
| `wheel_every_hours` | int | 24 | Hours between spins |
| `wheel_buyers_only` | bool | true | Wheel only for buyers |
| `wheel_prizes` | list | [{"label": "5,000", "kind": "wallet", "value": 5000, "weight": 30}, {"label": "10%", "kind": "discount", "value": 10, "weight": 20}, {"label": "20,000", "kind": "wallet", "value": 20000, "weight": 5}, {"label": "-", "kind": "nothing", "value": 0, "weight": 45}] | Wheel prizes. The chance of each slice is its weight against the total. Discount prizes become a one-time code valid for 7 days |
| `lottery_enabled` | bool | false | Lottery button. Shows the Lottery button in the bot. Lotteries themselves are set up on the Lotteries page |
| `trust_channel_id` | int | — | Trust channel. ID of a public channel where the bot is an admin. Each purchase is announced there with only a masked first name |

## Payments

| Key | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `min_topup` | int | 20000 | Minimum top-up |
| `max_topup` | int | 50000000 | Maximum top-up |
| `order_expire_minutes` | int | 60 | Order payment window (minutes) |
| `payment_expire_minutes` | int | 60 | Receipt window (minutes) |
| `card_enabled` | bool | true | Card transfer |
| `card_accounts` | list | [] | Cards. One of these is shown to each customer |
| `zarinpal_enabled` | bool | false | Zarinpal. Needs the server's public address |
| `zarinpal_merchant` | str (secret) | — | Zarinpal merchant ID |
| `zarinpal_sandbox` | bool | false | Zarinpal sandbox |
| `stars_enabled` | bool | false | Telegram Stars |
| `stars_rate` | int | 2000 | Toman per Star |
| `receipt_duplicate_block` | bool | false | Block duplicate receipts. When off, duplicates are only flagged |
| `card_auto_approve` | bool | false | Auto-approve receipts. Small receipts from customers with a clean history are approved without review; duplicates never are |
| `card_auto_max_amount` | int | 300000 | Auto-approve up to |
| `card_auto_min_history` | int | 3 | Approved receipts needed first |
| `topup_bonus_rules` | list | [] | Top-up bonus. A share of each top-up added as a gift. The largest matching bonus applies |
| `nowpayments_enabled` | bool | false | NowPayments |
| `nowpayments_api_key` | str (secret) | — | NowPayments API key |
| `nowpayments_ipn_secret` | str (secret) | — | NowPayments IPN secret |
| `plisio_enabled` | bool | false | Plisio |
| `plisio_api_key` | str (secret) | — | Plisio API key |

## More gateways

| Key | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `aqayepardakht_enabled` | bool | false | Aqayepardakht. Needs the server's public address |
| `aqayepardakht_pin` | str (secret) | — | Aqayepardakht PIN |
| `tetra98_enabled` | bool | false | Tetra98 (IranPay). Needs the server's public address |
| `tetra98_api_key` | str (secret) | — | Tetra98 API key |
| `variza_enabled` | bool | false | Variza. In the Variza panel set the webhook to your server's public address followed by /api/pay/gw/variza. Payments are credited only from that signed webhook |
| `variza_api_token` | str (secret) | — | Variza API token |
| `variza_webhook_secret` | str (secret) | — | Variza webhook secret |
| `abangateway_enabled` | bool | false | AbanGateway. Needs the server's public address |
| `abangateway_url` | str | "" | AbanGateway address. The https address AbanGateway gave you, without /create at the end |
| `abangateway_api_key` | str (secret) | — | AbanGateway API key |
| `abangateway_rial` | bool | true | AbanGateway reports amounts in Rial. Leave on unless AbanGateway tells you its verify answer is in Toman. A wrong choice keeps payments waiting for review; it never credits too much |
| `blupal_enabled` | bool | false | BluPal. Open invoices are checked every minute. For faster crediting set the webhook in the BluPal dashboard to your server's public address followed by /api/pay/gw/blupal |
| `blupal_api_key` | str (secret) | — | BluPal API key |
| `tronado_enabled` | bool | false | Tronado (TRX). Customers pay in TRX through the Tronado bot; the amount is converted at Tronado's rate. Needs the server's public address |
| `tronado_api_key` | str (secret) | — | Tronado API key |
| `tronado_ipn_key` | str (secret) | — | Tronado callback signing key |
| `tronado_wallet` | str | "" | Tronado TRON wallet. The TRC20 address Tronado pays out to. Use a different one from the wallet in the Crypto group |
| `tronado_wage_percent` | int | 0 | Share of Tronado's fee you pay (%). 0 means the customer pays the whole fee, 100 means you do |
| `cubepay_enabled` | bool | false | CubePay. Card-to-card and crypto through CubePay. Needs the server's public address |
| `cubepay_api_key` | str (secret) | — | CubePay API token |
| `cubepay_fee_percent` | int | 0 | CubePay fee added to the price (%). Added on top of what the customer pays at CubePay; the wallet gets the original amount |
| `atlaspay_enabled` | bool | false | AtlasPay. AtlasPay has no callback; open orders are checked every minute. AtlasPay's own markup is shown to the customer before paying |
| `atlaspay_api_key` | str (secret) | — | AtlasPay API key |

## Crypto

| Key | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `crypto_enabled` | bool | false | Direct crypto payments. Customers send straight to your wallet and transfers are recognised automatically |
| `crypto_networks` | list | ["usdt_trc20"] | Networks |
| `tron_address` | str | "" | TRON wallet address (TRC20). For USDT and TRX; starts with T |
| `ton_address` | str | "" | TON wallet address |
| `trongrid_api_key` | str (secret) | — | TronGrid key. Optional; from trongrid.io for higher limits |
| `toncenter_api_key` | str (secret) | — | Toncenter key |
| `fx_source` | str | "nobitex" | Exchange rate source. Nobitex refreshes every 5 minutes; the manual rate is used when it is unavailable |
| `usdt_rate` | int | 0 | Manual USDT rate (Toman) |
| `trx_rate` | int | 0 | Manual TRX rate (Toman) |
| `ton_rate` | int | 0 | Manual TON rate (Toman) |
| `fx_markup_percent` | int | 0 | Markup on the rate (%). Covers price swings and fees |

## Services

| Key | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `renew_resets_usage` | bool | true | Renewal resets usage. When off, leftover data carries over |
| `warn_remaining_percent` | int | 10 | Low data warning (% left) |
| `warn_days` | int | 2 | Expiry warning (days left) |
| `delete_expired_after_days` | int | 7 | Delete expired after (days). 0 means never |
| `usage_sync_minutes` | int | 10 | Usage sync interval (minutes) |
| `extras_enabled` | bool | true | Sell extra data and days |
| `extra_gb_price` | int | 3000 | Price per extra GB |
| `extra_day_price` | int | 2000 | Price per extra day |
| `upgrade_enabled` | bool | true | Plan upgrades |
| `renew_queue_when_active` | bool | false | Reserve renewals for active services. Renewing a service that still has time and data applies when the current period ends |
| `ban_disables_services` | bool | true | Banning disables services. Banning a customer turns their services off; unbanning turns them back on |
| `branded_sub_links` | bool | true | Subscription links on your domain. Customers see a /s/... link on the bot's domain and the panel address stays hidden |
| `app_links` | list | [] | App buttons on the subscription page. {url} becomes the subscription link and {title} the shop name |
| `move_enabled` | bool | true | Customers can change location. A button on each active service moves it to another location with its remaining data and end date |
| `move_price` | int | 0 | Location change price. 0 means free |
| `ip_notice_enabled` | bool | true | Tell customers when a device is cut off. For plans with a device limit on 3x-ui and Rebecca panels: when a new device pushes an older one off, the customer gets a short notice (at most once an hour) |
| `info_card_enabled` | bool | true | Service info card. A Card button on each service sends a picture with usage, days left, end date and the QR. After a purchase the card is sent instead of the bare QR |
| `info_card_theme` | str | "midnight" | Card colours. The colour set used for every service card |
| `info_card_qr` | bool | true | QR on the card. Turn off if customers share cards publicly and the link should stay private |
| `username_method` | str | "telegram_id" | Default username style |
| `username_prefix` | str | "" | Default prefix |
